agreements.title: Agreement required
agreements.message:
To start server “{{name}}”, accept the terms below.
{{list}}

perm.no_guilds: No Discord servers connected to this PC
perm.default_hint: Level given to anyone not set separately.
perm.ladder_hint: Higher rows are higher levels. Owner and banned can't be moved; owner, guest, and banned can't be deleted. Rename a level in its name field. To swap commands, press "Swap permissions" below and pick two levels.
perm.ladder_removed: Members of a deleted level move to the level just below, and commands that needed it move to the level just above.
perm.ladder_invalid: Enter a level name of 1–32 characters.
perm.notice_hint: Servers turned on are announced in this Discord server's alert channel when they start or stop outside Discord (app, web, CLI, schedule, auto restart, in game, crash). Starts and stops done from Discord are excluded.
perm.notice_empty: No servers used by this Discord server
perm.full_notice_hint: Servers turned on are announced in this Discord server's alert channel when they fill up or a slot opens again.
perm.instances_hint: Select an instance to see its commands per level. Member levels are set server-wide in the Member levels tab.
perm.members_server_wide: Member levels apply to all instances in this Discord server.
perm.stairs_failed: Loading or saving permissions failed. Check that Saba-chan is running and refresh.
perm.preset_reset: The levels of {{count}} command(s) are reset to the {{preset}} preset.
perm.moved_count: {{count}} command(s) moved away from the preset
perm.help_hint: help and list are open to everyone except banned, and can't be changed.
perm.fixed_hint: This command affects the whole PC, so its level can't be changed.
perm.risk_pc_hint: The word on the right is the confirmation step in Discord. Change it in the PC app.
perm.visible: Servers shown in this Discord server
perm.visible_hint: Servers turned off disappear from this Discord server's slash and prefix commands.

port_check.address: Public IP {{address}} (connect with this address and port)

verdict.no_ports: No port information to check for this game
verdict.host_mismatch: Public address doesn't point to this PC

hint.closed: Check that your router forwards this port to this PC and the PC firewall allows it.
hint.firewall: Windows Firewall is blocking incoming connections on this port. For the network you're connected to now (private or public), allow saba-core in Windows Firewall settings if the server is stopped, or the game server program if it is running, then check again.
hint.firewall_macos: The macOS firewall is blocking incoming connections for this server program. In System Settings › Network › Firewall › Options, set saba-core (if the server is stopped) or the game server program such as java (if running) to Allow incoming connections, then check again.
hint.router: The PC firewall allows this port. Forward this port to this PC in your router settings, then check again.
hint.cgnat: Your provider shares one public IP among several homes, so port forwarding can't open it. Ask your provider for a public IP or use a VPN such as Tailscale.
hint.unknown: UDP ports of a running server and ports used by other programs can't be checked. Stop the server and check again.
hint.host_mismatch: In your domain settings, point the A record to this PC's public IP. For DDNS, check that its updater is running. If a CDN proxy is on, turn it off; game connections can't pass through a proxy.
hint.host_unresolved: Check the spelling of the public address and your domain's DNS settings. For a newly created domain, check again shortly.
